crossmatch: Gaia DR3 hipparcos2_best_neighbour (Marrese et al. 2019 algorithm)
selection: Members with Gaia G<13 (covers the Hipparcos magnitude range) that have a Hipparcos-2 best neighbour. A HIP assigned to several Gaia sources or clusters is excluded as ambiguous.

gaia-dr3-hip2-best-neighbour.csv.query: SELECT source_id, original_ext_source_id, angular_distance, number_of_neighbours, xm_flag FROM gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour
